[Section] Experiments
[source_id=28] Here we compare the audio quality between our method and BIBREF0's method (Below we call USVC), and show that the input pitch can affect the output singing voice by qualitative analysis. Since the authors of BIBREF0 do not release their source code and only provide part of the converted results at their website, we implemented USVC by ourselves, denoted by USVC(our) below, to give a more comprehensive comparison. Audio samples are available at our website .
